title: Audit and fix table QR ordering flow

completed: static review of QR token scope, menu payload, order transaction, inventory reservation, staff acceptance and realtime payload
regression tests added for transaction sequencing, serialized retry, payment-pending capability and socket payload shape
notRun: targeted public table order backend Vitest
notes: GitHub connector does not expose a runnable checkout or browser.
Tracking/public status, table status and inventory reservation now commit with the order batch in one Mongo transaction.
Concurrent duplicate submissions serialize on the existing active table-session row, avoiding a new index migration.
Realtime failures after commit are logged instead of returning a false order failure to the customer.
Anonymous/linked identity storage remains scoped by restaurant and table in the frontend; session-specific identity hardening is outside this functional repair.
